title: Bundle authoring spec (bundle.spec/v1)
description: Public authoring contract for fwgen spec files (.toml/.json/.yaml) loaded by fwgen.parse_spec / fwgen.load_spec. Specs without `spec_version` are interpreted as `legacy` and normalized to this same internal model (STEP 8) — this schema documents that normalized shape, it does not change accepted input.

spec_version.description: Authoring contract version. Omit for legacy interpretation (default); "1" selects this schema explicitly. Both normalize to the same internal model.

title.description: Human-readable spec title; defaults to the file stem.

args.description: Candidate program argument tokens; defaults to ["noargs"].

runme.description: Java RunMeFirstOnce source override; defaults to an auto-generated stub.

slots.description: Per-sheet combination axes (the ONLY required field). Each becomes one Core FW_Seq row.

goals.description: Analyzer Pareto objectives. Either bare metric-name strings (direction auto-inferred) or {key, dir} objects.

custom_vars.description: Explicit FW_CUSTOM_VAR verdict codes/messages; defaults to a single generic code-2 verdict.

params.description: Constraint-sidecar value attributes: rows of {sheet, value, <attr>: <val>, ...}. Referenced sheets must be declared slots.

constraints.description: Allowed/forbidden bond rules enforced by constraints/sieve.py between Core and Reader (NOT the Core DSL). Each needs `pairs` or `when`; referenced sheets must be declared slots.

seq_extra.description: Raw advanced FW_Seq rows (brace joiners FW_(...), multi-verb, nested constructs) the per-slot model can't express directly. Each row is a list of cell strings; referenced sheets must be declared slots and brace operands must carry FW_Exclude/FW_Heading.

sheet.description: Data-sheet name; must NOT start with FW_ (reserved for control sheets).

key.description: Token key used in the assembled cell ('key=value'); defaults to sheet.lower().

values.description: Candidate values for this slot; row 0 is the baseline. Supports ${a|b} expansion unless raw=true.

verb.description: Core FW_Seq combination verb, e.g. FW_Combi(2), FW_CombiR(2), FW_Permut, FW_PermutR(2), FW_Subsets, FW_Subsets_EXACT(2), FW_Cartes(OTHER), FW_Group. Defaults to the standard cartesian verb. Mutually exclusive with `alias`.

alias.description: STEP 36: opt-in domain-level authoring alias that compiles to a raw `verb` (+flags): choose_one->FW_Combi(1); choose_k(k)->FW_Combi(k); permute[(k)]->FW_Permut[(k)]; feature_subset[(k)]->FW_Subsets[(k)]; optional_action->FW_Combi(1)+FW_Optional. Mutually exclusive with `verb` (a slot uses one or the other).

flags.description: Extra FW_Seq flags, e.g. FW_Optional, FW_Exclude, FW_Heading.

raw.description: Emit values verbatim (no 'key=' prefix, no ${} expansion) — for code pieces.

separator.description: FW_Separator(<sheet>) operand: must name another declared slot.

group_replace.description: FW_Group FW_ReplaceRE rewrites: list of [pattern, replacement] pairs.

not.description: A slot may carry EITHER a domain `alias` OR a raw `verb`, never both (STEP 36 conflict rule).
